basic_details.job_title: NABCONS Associate Project Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NABARD Consultancy Services (NABCONS) has announced 2 vacancies for the Associate Project Consultant post on a contract basis for a period of 11 months under advertisement number NABCONS/CO-HR/22/PBCS/2026-27. Candidates holding a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in IT or Computer sciences and meeting the age limit of up to 35 years can apply for this recruitment. The notified pay ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 75,000 based upon experience and last drawn salary. Eligible applicants must submit their online applications from 19 October 2026 to 25 October 2026. rows.essential_qualification: Graduate / Post Graduate in IT / Computer sciences with between 3 - 5 years of experience in IT related projects.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Associate Project Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Support team leader in program management. Conduct financial analysis and review the reports for generating insights. Coordinate with commercial banks for NRLM IS related issues. Provide IT related technical support for development or any change requests. Engage in stakeholder coordination for smooth operations. Oversee the overall project implementation and ensure all Key Performance Indicators are completed on time. Identify any challenges or bottlenecks and provide necessary support for timely resolution. Any other works assigned by the NABCONS/DoF.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NABCONS Associate Project Consultant
content_sections.text: Access the online application form link provided by NABCONS. Fill in all the required details in the prescribed format. Ensure the application is submitted on or before 25 October 2026 (Midnight).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview and may also be assessed for their proficiency in MS Office and data management. The interview may be held in person or through virtual mode as required. Self-attested copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates must be submitted at the time of the interview, along with original documents for verification. Candidates bear their own travel costs for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Associate Project Consultant post?
faq.answer: There are 02 vacancies available for the Associate Project Consultant post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 25 October 2026 (Midnight).

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in IT or Computer sciences with 3 to 5 years of experience in IT related projects.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The preferred age is up to 35 years, with preference given to Mumbai-based candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the offered monthly salary?
faq.answer: The total monthly CTC ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 75,000, commensurate based upon experience and last drawn salary.

faq.question: Q6. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The Project Based Contract Staff would be hired for a period of 11 months, which may be extended based on project requirements and performance or co-terminus with the project period.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on preliminary screening and shortlisting of candidates, followed by an interview and potential assessment for proficiency in MS Office and data management.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the place of posting for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The place of posting is Mumbai, though candidates can be posted anywhere in India depending on project requirements.
